pageTypes.label: Premium hero section
pageTypes.goal: Above-the-fold moment that sells one idea — custom visual, intentional type, motion, interaction. NOT a template headline + gradient blob.
conceptQuestions: What single visual metaphor represents this product in 5 seconds?
What does the user feel before they read the subcopy?
What is the ONE action after this hero?
layoutPatterns: Split asymmetric — copy left, visual right
Editorial overlap — type through visual plane
interactionDefaults: GSAP entrance stagger on hero load
Pointer or scroll affects at least one visual layer
antiPatterns: Centered Inter headline + purple gradient blob
Split SaaS hero: copy column + abstract orb/node visual
Syne / Space Grotesk / DM Sans / Plus Jakarta as display font
Buzzword copy: build faster, 10x, revolutionize, before the meeting ends

pageTypes.label: Premium landing section
pageTypes.goal: Conversion section with art direction — not a feature grid template.
conceptQuestions: What story does this section tell in one glance?
Why this layout and not a 3-column grid?

pageTypes.label: Creative 404 page
pageTypes.goal: Memorable error moment — concept + assets + motion. Study senior creative bar.
conceptQuestions: What does 'not found' mean in this brand world?
Why would someone remember this page?

pageTypes.label: Premium pricing section
pageTypes.goal: Plans with typographic hierarchy and restraint — not SaaS template cards.
conceptQuestions: Which plan should the eye hit first?
What makes this pricing feel designed not generated?
interactionDefaults: Billing toggle with NumberFlow (or odometer) on price change — not textContent swap
Toggle segment pressed state + meta line sync
antiPatterns: Serif tier titles or editorial display above billing toggle

pageTypes.label: Premium empty state
pageTypes.goal: Zero-data moment with personality — illustration or geometry, not sad folder icon.
conceptQuestions: What emotion when there's nothing here yet?
What's the one action to fix it?

pageTypes.label: Personal portfolio
pageTypes.goal: Quiet premium personal site — lists, whitespace, curated objects, one hover moment per section. NOT dark scrub hero.
conceptQuestions: What three sections tell your story (experience, work, experiments)?
What is the ONE hover or expand moment visitors remember?
Why system UI or editorial type — not a template portfolio?
interactionDefaults: Hover preview or expand on one section
antiPatterns: Dark split scrub hero as entire portfolio
Dark zinc developer console with lime accent
Custom cursor + grain canvas + glow stack
Density token demo as entire hero
Production front-end headline on black field

pageTypes.label: Auth / OTP screen
pageTypes.goal: Single-task focus — code entry with atmosphere that responds to input. NOT static wallpaper.
conceptQuestions: What emotion at login — trust, speed, calm?
How does the background react when a digit is focused or filled?
What is the one escape path if code fails?
antiPatterns: Static full-page gradient with dead UI
Fraunces or editorial serif headline on login/checkout
